sources.title: llama.cpp v1.0.0：为本地 AI 生态打下更坚实的基础 / llama.cpp v1.0.0 : A stronger foundation for the local AI ecosystem
sources.title_zh: llama.cpp v1.0.0：为本地 AI 生态打下更坚实的基础
sources.title_en: llama.cpp v1.0.0 : A stronger foundation for the local AI ecosystem
sources.title_original: llama.cpp v1.0.0 : A stronger foundation for the local AI ecosystem
sources.summary:
A Blog post by ggml-org on Hugging Face
A Blog post by ggml-org on Hugging Face
llama.cpp makes it possible to run multi-modal LLMs across a wide range of hardware - from consumer-grade local machines to high-end enterprise servers. Through quantization, optimized backends, and a portable C/C++ implementation, we make AI inference accessible at every level of the software stack. We believe this is the most lightweight, versatile and sensible platform for building cross-platform and private AI pr
sources.recommend_reason_zh: llama.cpp 发布 v1.0.0，用主版本号明确 API/ABI 兼容边界；项目历经 3.5 年，已支持 150 多种模型架构变体和主流投机解码，并借助 NVIDIA、AMD 等硬件与 HF Jobs 扩展 CI。

en.reason: llama.cpp v1.0.0 marks the project’s first major release after 3.5 years, setting an API/ABI compatibility boundary while supporting over 150 model architecture variants, mainstream speculative decoding, and CI expanded via NVIDIA, AMD hardware and HF Jobs.

sources.title_en: Actions for ARM32 Linux & Windows retirement
sources.title_original: Actions for ARM32 Linux & Windows retirement

sources.title_original: Former OpenAI researcher says he found Nvidia Blackwell fingerprints hidden inside six Chinese AI models
sources.summary:
Former OpenAI researcher Will DePue says he has produced the first technical evidence that DeepSeek, Moonshot AI, MiniMax, and Ant Group are using Nvidia's latest Blackwell GPUs despite US export controls. sources.title_original: Nearly 70 percent of US agencies use generative AI, and unions are finally catching up with guardrails
sources.summary:
US public-sector unions are increasingly pushing through protections against AI surveillance and automated firings. In Oakland, a strike vote forced retraining programs instead of layoffs, and a transport union in Ohio won veto power over autonomous vehicles. California banned so-called bossware. All of this is happening while nearly 70 percent of US government agencies already use generative AI.

sources.title_original: Meta's Muse now calls businesses for you, but many companies might just hang up on the AI

Meta's AI agent Muse can now call businesses on behalf of paying US subscribers, handling everything from cable providers to restaurants. The agent already has over 10 million users, according to Meta's AI chief Alexandr Wang. Google Gemini, Instinct, and xAI's Grok Bot offer the same feature, but many businesses hang up as soon as they detect an AI on the line.

sources.recommend_reason_zh: Google发布开源C++库TPU Sync，把TPU HBM、主机DRAM、共享存储和数据中心网络视为统一内存层级，称在235B至480B参数MoE模型上KV缓存传输延迟降低超90%。

en.reason: Google released TPU Sync, an open-source C++ library that treats TPU HBM, host DRAM, shared storage and the data center network as one memory hierarchy and cuts KV cache transfer latency over 90% on 235B-to-480B-parameter MoE models.

sources.recommend_reason_zh: Docker指南称低监督智能体面临提示词注入、工具滥用等五大风险，并以rm -rf ~/误删主目录和AWS工程师致13小时中断为例，主张容器隔离与治理。

en.title: Docker calls for isolation and governance to secure Agents
en.reason: Docker's Srini Sekaran and Eric Jia outline five runtime risks for low-supervision AI agents—prompt injection, tool abuse, excessive autonomy, credential leakage and data theft—and argue container isolation plus policy governance, not model-layer fixes, are the core defenses.

stories.title: 李彦宏 11 月 12 日在百度世界 2026 上给了一个很具体的比喻：企业 Token 花费在涨、利润没涨，是因为只换了「AI 新电机」，没重新设计「新厂房」。他把下一幕叫智能组织，给了三条原则：打破岗位边界、沉淀隐性知识、设计能跑通的完整流程。 这句话把 AI ROI 的问题从模型层拉回组织层。买模型是可见成本，重设计流程是隐性成本；多数企业愿意付前者，不愿意付后者，因为前者有发票，后者要动人和权限。 Token 账单是线性的，流…

en.title: AI writes code at blistering speed—then what? A look at my workflow for reviewing generated code.

en.title: Why Can't We Just Throw Our Requirements at AI Yet?
en.summary:
Why Can't We Just Hand Our Requirements Straight to AI?

AI quickly located the order endpoint, added status checks, updated the database, wired up notification logic, and even wrote the tests. Looking at a wall of passing results, you figure this round of development is basically done. Then a product colleague asks: "For an order that's already been paid, once it's canceled—
en.reason: The article uses an “add order cancellation” task to show that even when AI writes code and all tests pass, an unasked product question—when is a paid order refunded—exposes unspecified business rules around inventory release, coupon restoration and refund API timeouts.

sources.summary: 对于想转型 AI 的产品经理来说，面对从 GPU 到 Agent 的庞大技术体系，究竟应该学什么、学到什么程度？又该怎样把技术知识转化成实际的产品能力？这篇《技术能力全景指南》就是围绕这四个问题展开的。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 这篇指南沿GPU/NPU、HBM到PyTorch/DeepSpeed拆解五层技术栈，用四项核心判断能力和真实案例，讲清AI PM该学什么、学到什么程度及如何验收。

en.title: AI Product Manager Technical Skills Guide: From GPU to Agent (with Learning Guide)
en.summary: For product managers looking to move into AI, the technical landscape—stretching from GPUs to Agents—is vast. What should they actually learn, and how deep do they need to go? And how do they turn technical knowledge into real product capability? This "Complete Guide to the Technical Landscape" is organized around these four questions.
en.reason: A five-layer AI tech stack spanning GPU/NPU and HBM up to PyTorch/DeepSpeed is mapped against four core judgment capabilities and real cases to show AI product managers what to learn, how deeply, and how to validate it.

sources.title_original: 一个人指挥一支 AI 剧组：Gemini 4 + Omni 1.2 剧情短片制作保姆级教程
sources.summary: AI 视频最怕镜头单看都不错，拼起来却人物变脸、台词吞字、字幕乱跑。作者用 Gemini 4 搭配 Omni 1.2，把一个西游记喜剧点子做成完整短片，也把从剧本、分镜到生成、配音、后期的七步流程摊开了。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 教程用 Gemini 4 和 Omni 1.2 制作《真假美猴王》等监控视角西游记喜剧，拆解从剧本分镜到重配音、代码后期的全流程，并附解决人物串戏和中文吞尾音的提示词。

en.title: One person directing an entire AI crew: a step-by-step tutorial for making a narrative short film with Gemini 4 + Omni 1.2
en.summary: The Achilles' heel of AI video: every shot looks fine on its own, but once they're stitched together, faces morph, lines get swallowed, and subtitles drift. The author paired Gemini 4 with Omni 1.2 to turn a Journey to the West comedy idea into a complete short film, laying out the full seven-step workflow from script and storyboard through generation, voiceover, and post-production.
en.reason: Gemini 4 and Omni 1.2 drive a seven-step tutorial for a monitor-view Journey to the West comedy short, covering script, storyboard, generation, voiceover and postproduction, plus prompts to fix character swaps and swallowed Chinese line endings.

sources.summary: 装好 DeepSeek Harness 后却卡在一众插件前：该装哪个？装完去哪找？这篇文章从桌面端安装讲起，把 7 款工作台按上手难度分好类，覆盖自媒体排版、产品原型、小游戏等场景，或许可以帮你快速找到最适合你的插件。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 万字指南详解 DeepSeek 官方开源 Agent 运行时底座 DeepSeek Harness，说明“一切皆插件”如何把输入框变成排版台、UI 原型画布，并给出3分钟桌面端安装及 macOS 13+、Apple 芯片避坑细节。

en.title: Long Read | The Complete Guide to DeepSeek Harness: Build Your Own Custom Workbench
en.summary: Installed DeepSeek Harness but stuck staring at a pile of plugins: which one should you install, and where do you find them once they're installed? Starting with the desktop installation, this article sorts seven workbenches by difficulty, covering use cases from social media layout to product prototypes and mini-games — it may help you quickly find the plugin that suits you best.
en.reason: A 10,000-word guide to DeepSeek's open-source Agent runtime Harness explains its "everything is a plugin" design, which turns the input box into a typesetting desk or UI prototyping canvas, and covers a 3-minute desktop install plus macOS 13+ and Apple chip pitfalls.

sources.title: 如何从老需求出发，找 AI 新词？
sources.title_zh: 如何从老需求出发，找 AI 新词？
sources.title_original: 如何从老需求出发，找 AI 新词？
sources.summary: 想做 AI 工具，又不知道“做什么有人用”？可以先翻翻用户早就在搜的老需求。作者以字体生成器为例，演示了如何用 Ahrefs 找出生成、编辑、转换等需求，再查看加上 AI 后的搜索趋势，顺着关键词就能找到近期流量上涨的对标产品。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 文章以 generator 词根为例，讲从 meme generator 这类老需求组合 AI 找新词，如 ai meme generator，并给出先找老需求、再组合 AI 看趋势的方法。

en.title: How to Find New AI Terms by Starting from Old Needs
en.summary: Want to build an AI tool but not sure what people would actually use? Start by digging into the old demands users have been searching for all along. Using font generators as an example, the author shows how to use Ahrefs to surface needs around generation, editing, and conversion, then check the search trends once "AI" is added—following those keywords leads you to comparable products that have seen recent traffic growth.
en.reason: Using Ahrefs, the article shows how to mine long-standing search demands like “meme generator,” test combinations such as “ai meme generator,” and track AI-augmented search trends to spot competitors with rising traffic.

stories.title: 怎么好好的AI，到我手里就不好用了？

sources.title: 怎么好好的AI，到我手里就不好用了？
sources.title_zh: 怎么好好的AI，到我手里就不好用了？
sources.title_original: 怎么好好的AI，到我手里就不好用了？
sources.summary: 为什么别人用 AI 很顺手，轮到自己却越用越费劲？梦飞用 WorkBuddy 演示了一条对于小白而言更容易上手的路：挑一件自己熟悉的小事，说清目标、范围和不能改的地方，只给相关材料；看到第一版结果后，再具体指出哪里要调整。如果你也总觉得 AI“不懂我”，可以跟着做一次。先让它帮你完成一件小事，后面才更容易用起来。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 他写了200篇AI文章、分享数百小时，却发现媳妇用AI两次解决不了问题就不再用，换成GPT也骂笨，于是借WorkBuddy讲靠正反馈做成一件小事来开始用好AI。

en.title: Why does a perfectly good AI suddenly turn useless in my hands?
en.summary: Why does AI feel so effortless for everyone else, while the more you use it, the more of a struggle it becomes? Mengfei uses WorkBuddy to demonstrate a path that's easier for beginners to get started with: pick one small task you're familiar with, spell out the goal, the scope, and what must not be changed, and give it only the relevant materials; after seeing the first draft, point out specifically what needs adjusting. If you've also been feeling that AI "doesn't get me," try following along once. Let it finish one small task for you first — only then does it become easier to use down the road.

sources.title_original: Why is Google cutting off Search from AI-free schools? Here are some theories
sources.summary:
Text-Only Version Go To Full Site
NPR > K-12 Education
By Sequoia Carrillo
Friday, November 13, 2026 • 5:00 AM EST
Catch up on what you missed with our Education newsletter, sent weekly.
Google is a big part of the school day for millions of students. It's not only a search engine. It's a hub for sharing documents and turning in homework.
An announcement this month makes it clear: Google wants AI to be a part of that education ecosystem.
Many parents do not.
"Parents are angry," said Jodi Carreo
sources.recommend_reason_zh: NPR报道Google让想关AI Overviews的学校连Search也失去，纽约市等学区已同意课堂禁AI，前员工Tracy Pizzo称这与两起反垄断案认定Search和AI为整合产品有关。

en.reason: Schools that disable Google AI Overviews also lose Search, NPR reports, while New York City and other districts agree to classroom AI bans and ex-employee Tracy Pizzo links it to two antitrust rulings treating Search and AI as integrated.

en.reason: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei refused in late July to sign a Microsoft- and Nvidia-backed open-model letter endorsed by more than 200 companies including OpenAI, even as Anthropic leads AI development and prepares a large IPO.

Author of the AI Insider newsletter
Here's a clever way to save money on your next vacation rental. And it shows how AI agents can make everyday tasks easier.
Nicolas Bustamante, an AI executive at Microsoft, recently shared a trick on X that saved his family 14
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Microsoft的AI高管Nicolas Bustamante在X上演示，让AI agent按相同日期搜索同一Airbnb房源的官网、核对可订状态并直接预订，最终为家庭省下14%费用。

en.reason: Microsoft AI executive Nicolas Bustamante showed on X how an AI agent searched the same Airbnb property on its own website for identical dates, verified availability and booked directly, saving his family 14%.

stories.title: Amodei 称 AI 十年内可治愈癌症，医生们表示怀疑 / Amodei Says AI Will Cure Cancer in a Decade. Doctors Are Skeptical

sources.title: Amodei 称 AI 十年内可治愈癌症，医生们表示怀疑 / Amodei Says AI Will Cure Cancer in a Decade. Doctors Are Skeptical
sources.title_zh: Amodei 称 AI 十年内可治愈癌症，医生们表示怀疑
sources.title_en: Amodei Says AI Will Cure Cancer in a Decade. Doctors Are Skeptical
sources.title_original: Amodei Says AI Will Cure Cancer in a Decade. Doctors Are Skeptical
sources.summary:
Some in the medical community aren't so certain that AI will cure cancer and Alzheimer's in the next decade, as Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei predicted.
Some in the medical community aren't so certain that AI will cure cancer and Alzheimer's in the next decade, as Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei predicted.
A cure for cancer is less than a decade away, if you ask Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei.
If you ask some in the medical community, though, that timeline is a bit ambitious, if not altogether unrealistic.
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 这篇报道呈现Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei在42分钟IPO路演视频中预言癌症、阿尔茨海默病等不到十年将被AI治愈，以及Karl Lauterbach等医学人士质疑该时间表并指其可能误导公众的争议。

en.reason: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei predicts in a 42-minute IPO roadshow video that AI will cure cancer and Alzheimer's within a decade, while medical figures including Karl Lauterbach question the timeline and warn it may mislead the public.

sources.title_zh: Gemini 4 Hydrogen 和 Orchestrator
sources.title_original: Gemini 4 Hydrogen 和 Orchestrator
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Google Antigravity 正式上线 Gemini 4 Hydrogen，并新增 Orchestrator 下拉选项，让 Gemini 4 Carbon 负责规划、Hydrogen 执行编辑与测试，遇阻再交回 Carbon；官方称在 Terminal-Bench 4.1 上平均少耗 24% 配额、快 19%。

en.title: Gemini 4 Hydrogen and Orchestrator
en.reason: Google Antigravity now offers Gemini 4 Hydrogen and an Orchestrator dropdown that lets Gemini 4 Carbon plan while Hydrogen handles edits and tests, handing back when blocked; Google claims 24% lower quota use and 19% faster runs on Terminal-Bench 4.1.

en.reason: Anthropic's 9 November 2026 release of Claude Fable 5.2 coordinated over 1,000 sub-agents for eight days to deliver a bootable operating system prototype, and the piece examines what that gap between demo and maintainable product means for how developers specify tasks and acceptance criteria.

sources.title_original: Anthropic lets companies run Claude’s agent service on their own servers
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Anthropic开放企业自托管Claude Managed Agents，agent历史与凭证可留在自家云或数据中心，但每次模型调用仍发往Anthropic或AWS等外部提供方，且需重建数据、缺少webhooks和定时任务，清晰呈现控制权与代价。

en.reason: Anthropic now lets companies self-host Claude Managed Agents so agent data and credentials stay in their own cloud or data center, though every model call still goes to Anthropic or an external provider like AWS, and teams must rebuild data without webhooks or scheduled tasks.

items.recommend_reason_zh: India一座全新公共图书馆因馆内出现由陌生作者撰写、内容充满错误的AI books而面临反腐败调查，报道聚焦这些书如何进入馆藏并引发官方审查。

en.reason: A new public library in India faces an anti-corruption investigation after shelves were filled with AI-generated books by unfamiliar authors containing inaccuracies, with reporting tracing how these titles entered the collection and triggered official scrutiny.
